visual_direction.style: photorealistic cinematic dark fantasy grounded in contemporary real-world materials, anatomy, lighting and ecology
references_as_principles: credible human proportions and facial expression
visual_direction.originality: Create original characters, silhouettes, environments, icons and interface; do not copy protected assets or signature designs from other games.

features.nanite: Enable for compatible high-detail static environment meshes; verify per asset and platform.
features.lumen: Use dynamic global illumination and reflections where supported; provide scalable fallbacks.
features.virtual_shadow_maps: Enable where supported and profile memory/performance.
features.virtual_textures: Use for suitable large texture sets; validate streaming and memory.
features.temporal_upscaling: Support engine temporal upscaling and platform-native upscalers where available.
features.hdr: Optional and display-dependent; preserve SDR tone mapping.

performance_targets.high_end_pc: Target stable 60 FPS at 4K on a declared reference GPU/CPU after profiling; not a universal guarantee.
performance_targets.console: Define per-platform resolution, frame-rate and memory budgets after hardware selection.
performance_targets.minimum_pc: Scalable settings, resolution scaling, texture streaming and a playable frame-rate target to be benchmarked.

acceptance_requires: no blocking shader compilation during the benchmark

characters.anatomy: Believable proportions, weight distribution, facial anatomy and non-uniform skin response.
materials: mud, dust, moisture and damage layers
characters.customization: Readable silhouettes, layered equipment, dye channels and accessibility-friendly previews.
characters.rule: No final-quality claim until skeletal meshes, rigs, animation sets, LODs and in-game lighting are tested.

systems: footprints and material-dependent effects where supported
nature.composition: Use authored landmarks and ecological logic; avoid uniform tree rings and visibly repeated assets.

interface.target: 4K-ready, legible, controller- and mouse-friendly game UI
principles: responsive layout rather than fixed 4K coordinates
hierarchy for objective, health, abilities and interaction
subtitles, text scaling and color-accessibility options
interface.visual_language: premium restrained cinematic interface with material depth and restrained animation; gameplay information always takes priority
requirements: verify UI scaling at 100%, 125%, 150% and 200% where platform permits

quality_gates.rule: Never mark an asset, map, character, animation, interface or performance target complete without the matching evidence.
first_vertical_slice: one controllable hero with a rigged production-intent mesh
one walkable region with authored terrain and vegetation
one enemy archetype and one boss encounter
